controlled_input: Expert tissue masks are coarsened to a 90-pixel grid and their identities permuted independently per image. The fine mask is absent from Bora predictor manifests.
primary_endpoints: whole-group classification accuracy with class-balanced accuracy
tumor-stroma boundary F1 at 8 micrometres where an expert interface exists
whole-group accuracy by input tile count
per-image pipeline time excluding Virchow2 extraction and cold model load
comparison: Expert-decoded coarse tile identity is a privileged geometry diagnostic, not an inference comparator.
large_image_examples: Five WSI images and three Visium sections are processed separately with bounded windows/tiles. Only independently verified expert tissue regions are scored; other images are descriptive.
analysis_status: preprocessing and fixed-protocol implementation in progress; no final rerun scores yet
publication_gate: Replace all manuscript tables, figures and public viewer scores only after complete receipt and provenance audit.
